screening.method: Screened all 100 titles, bodies and file inventories, including test changes in feature/release PRs, collection changes and test-methodology documents. Read candidate file patches, checked commit histories where the net diff or description was ambiguous, queried final-head check rollups for all PRs and inspected selected historical job logs. #78 is a confirmed issue, not a missing PR.

matching_prs.title: Claude/codebase audit 011 cuml yzc5 gdj vpo en d3161

matching_prs.title: fix: Handle numpy types in JSON serialization + enable branch coverage
matching_prs.weakness: Three-note fixtures could never reach clustering with min_cluster_size=5, hiding NumPy keys that failed serialization.
matching_prs.remedy: Seed 15 embeddings across clusters, exercise cache retrieval, add direct JSON format tests, and enable branch measurement.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The cache case generates 15 notes and re-reads metrics. Direct tests supply int64 keys, nested scalar types and arrays, then parse the serialized JSON. The cluster assertions are guarded by n_clusters>0.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Cross a real branch threshold and include a direct known failing value. Require the expected intermediate state in a positive case.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. The fixture increases reachability but conditional cluster assertions can still pass without clustering. The TOML change enables measurement and only documents a possible fail-under threshold.

matching_prs.title: test: Add comprehensive unit tests for 34 remaining geists

matching_prs.title: Plan Command pattern for CLI operations

matching_prs.title: Refactor stats module: extract metrics and formatting to dedicated modules
matching_prs.weakness: Modifier tests finished with assert True when all 100 seeds missed the very behavior they claimed. A broad audit also identified untested modules and brittle timing checks.
matching_prs.remedy: Make seed exhaustion a failure and add property-based suites for parsing, embeddings and config round trips.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Two terminal assert True fallbacks become explicit failures for missing capitalizeAll or chained modifiers. New tests cover round trips and scalar properties, though the original frontmatter property accepts body2==body or fm2 is None.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: A bounded search that cannot find its target must fail. Independently scrutinize properties added by an audit.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. #83 later replaced weak parsing/embedding properties. The successful hosted head does not demonstrate every generated oracle could catch its intended defect.

matching_prs.title: Pre-1.0 quality pass: revive broken geists, fix the #78 timeout cliff, make spec verification actually verify
matching_prs.weakness: Green len(output)>=0 checks hid non-firing shipped geists. The acceptance checker trusted checked boxes and silently omitted malformed criteria.
matching_prs.remedy: Add firing fixtures and nonempty/negative cases, fix the test-writing template, and execute parseable acceptance commands while surfacing manual cases.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The template deletes its unconditional len>=0 sample. assert_valid_suggestions requires len>=min_count. A claim-rich vault must yield 'claimed' suggestions, while plain prose produces []. The gate removes counting a checkmark as success and fails on unparseable rows.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Separate fixture trigger, positive output and counterexample. An executable acceptance claim needs executed evidence and complete accounting of targets.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. #91, #92 and #94 show that introducing a helper and a command runner still left unused helpers, empty outputs and partial/deselected evidence.
matching_prs.hosted_head_checks: SUCCESS (3 success)

matching_prs.title: Harden SQLite synchronization and transaction correctness
matching_prs.weakness: Same-connection or fresh-state tests could not prove recovery, normalized vectors hid magnitude defects, and a 1,000-embedding test asserted only that a list was returned.
matching_prs.remedy: Cross process/storage boundaries and compare with independent expectations; build a cheaper exact corpus that distinguishes sampling from full traversal.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The crash test requires a child exit code of 73, opens a separate observer and checks pending files and recovered DB state. Phase3B uses 503 notes, plants a phrase starting at index 500, asserts all paths were read and asserts the phrase surfaced. The cosine property compares non-unit vectors to a scalar math.fsum reference.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Match the observation boundary to the claim. Use an independent known answer just beyond the historical failure threshold.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. These diffs establish sensitivity to the named boundary errors. The PR's broader generated and stress-test claims were not replayed in this audit.
matching_prs.hosted_head_checks: SUCCESS (5 success)

matching_prs.title: Harden runtime safety, persistence, and release artifacts
matching_prs.classification: explicit harness, skip and artifact audit
matching_prs.weakness: A global embedding patch selected by command spelling hid loader/model packaging mistakes. Some tests skipped on unexpected empty outputs, missing fixtures or missing logs. Competing pytest configs changed collection.
matching_prs.remedy: Select the stub at the constructor based on collected markers, consolidate pytest config, remove permissive skips, and verify the installed wheel with real offline weights.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Removes pytest.ini, checks that pytestconfig.inipath is pyproject.toml, and replaces the no-clusters skip with designed inputs. An out-of-checkout smoke checks site-packages, rejects LFS pointer bytes, asserts a real SentenceTransformer and finite (3,384) embeddings.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Verify the distribution users install, including unconditional packaging preconditions. Make environmental skips explicit rather than swallowing behavioral failures.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. The then-current coverage threshold still combined statements and branches; #85 replaced it with a branch-only gate.
matching_prs.hosted_head_checks: SUCCESS (5 success)

matching_prs.title: Harden project after cross-cutting audit
matching_prs.classification: explicit coverage, stateful and oracle audit
matching_prs.weakness: Combined coverage mislabeled as branch coverage could hide untested branches. Membership-only parsing properties accepted extra/reordered output, and timed/performance checks did not necessarily measure work.
matching_prs.remedy: Count actual branch destinations, strengthen generated assertions and stateful edits, and instrument SQL statements.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The gate totals coverage.branch_stats() taken/possible destinations under src and self-tests a 40/100 counterexample. Properties compare exact sorted tags/ordered links, state-machine writes can preserve original mtime, and SQL trace checks replace estimated costs.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Measure the claimed quantity directly and compare complete observable results. Generate transitions that would defeat the old state-identity assumption.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. The reported 71.20% branch figure is PR evidence. The code and green head checks establish the gate that ran, not complete functional coverage.
matching_prs.hosted_head_checks: SUCCESS (5 success)

matching_prs.title: Stabilize periodic SIGALRM cancellation test
matching_prs.weakness: A sleep of 90 ms did not guarantee an asynchronous alarm had arrived. A mutable counter could change after evaluating an assertion but before pytest printed it.
matching_prs.remedy: Wait for the condition with a monotonic deadline and assert an immutable captured delivery flag while keeping timer-cancellation checks.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: The handler sets delivered=True. A loop waits until delivery or a one-second deadline under a separate two-second timeout, then snapshots delivered_in_time before asserting it.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Synchronize with the event under test and snapshot mutable asynchronous state before making assertions.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. GitHub job 103537526848 on macOS/Python 3.11 records the exact pre-fix failure, test_host_handler_can_cancel_its_periodic_alarm: assert 1 >= 1. The author's 500 repetitions were not independently replayed.
matching_prs.hosted_head_checks: SUCCESS (5 success)

matching_prs.title: Harden replay diagnostics and release contracts
matching_prs.weakness: Temporal tests accepted an empty list or inferred meaning from calendar dimensions. A package could also be tested then rebuilt for publication.
matching_prs.remedy: Force positive semantic-drift fixtures and separate calendar-only negative controls. Promote tested artefacts through the tag workflow.
matching_prs.diff_evidence: Burst checks change from list/type and <=1 with a loop to exactly one suggestion. Session-drift tests plant different semantic snapshots and assert suggestions before comparing text. Calendar-only change must have zero semantic direction. The initial release workflow contract checks literal YAML text.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Use contrasted fixtures to distinguish causal signals, and verify promotion by observable artifact contents.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. #89 and #90 repaired two actual tag failures missed by the release contract. #94 replaced its literal-line checks.
matching_prs.hosted_head_checks: SUCCESS (5 success, 1 skipped)

matching_prs.title: Fix release artifact retention
